title: pnpm monorepo
about: A pnpm workspace with three packages: a Lambda function, an Express server and a shared `utils` package both import. The Lambda function sits behind an HTTP API and imports from the sibling workspace package, which every tool has to resolve through pnpm's symlinked `node_modules`.
changesFromStarter: Only the Lambda function is deployed. The starter also deploys `packages/server` as a container (`web-service`); that path is covered by the container comparison, and three of the four tools have no container packaging to compare. The package stays in the workspace.
The workspace file allows the builds pnpm 11 asks approval for (esbuild and the tools' own binaries) and turns off its 24-hour minimum release age, so the pinned versions install.
Every direct dependency is pinned to an exact version.
